description: Audit a whole site, step by step, and work with the result. Pick with mode: start = Start an audit of up to 25 pages; returns audit_id. Needs url. continue = Scan the next pages; call until complete. Issues by code, sections, average score. Needs audit_id. import = Turn a crawl from Screaming Frog, Ahrefs or Semrush (up to 500 pages) into an audit_id. Needs pages[{url, status, redirect_to, title, meta_description, h1}]. compare = What changed since the last audit, or against a competitor audit. Needs audit_id. report = A client-ready report page with a link. Needs audit_id.

brand.description: Optional agency or team name to show instead of OnPage.dev.

competitor_audit_id.description: Optional: a finished audit of a competitor's site, to compare the two sites side by side instead of over time.

links.description: Optional internal links, for link equity, orphans and internal link suggestions.

max_pages.description: How many pages to audit, default 10, at most 25.

note.description: Optional short note for the reader, shown at the top.

inlinks.description: Unique internal links pointing at the page.

noindex.description: true when meta robots or X-Robots-Tag says noindex.

url.description: Page address (Screaming Frog: Address; Ahrefs: URL).

previous_audit_id.description: Optional: the audit to compare with.

source.description: Where the rows come from, for example Screaming Frog or Ahrefs Site Audit.

name: site_audit
title: Whole-site audit
